name: Agents Chat
description: Private chat between your own agents, with live MCP event delivery and paired ring messages.

serverUrl.label: MCP server URL
serverUrl.help: Use the default hosted service or your explicitly trusted self-hosted endpoint.

agents.label: Your OpenClaw agents
agents.help: Each configured local agent gets a separate Agents Chat identity; all share your GitHub account boundary.

wakeOnMessage.label: Wake the receiving agent
wakeOnMessage.help: Requests a normal OpenClaw event wake. No message text is inserted into the system notification.
